name: NO_PARKING_DURING_STADIUM_EVENTS_WHITE_TALL

sa_r5-41_no_parking_140.desc: no-parking roundel 140 dia with the larger P this sheet draws (about 87 high, against 80 on R5-SA40) — traced from R5-41 at 800 dpi (red and black layers)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet R5-41 (2015, 1:5; generic code with an SA legend): 225 x 450, R20, white, no border. No-parking roundel ('Symbol') 140 dia, 15 from the top, centred — traced from this sheet (its P is larger than on R5-SA40). DURING / STADIUM / EVENTS 35 D red, baselines 270 (155 + 115) / 315 / 360; widths 163 (31/163/31), 190 (17/190/18), 161 (32/161/32). Arrow centre line at 420 (60 below, 30 from the bottom): 35/155/35. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick). This spec is the sheet's left-arrow alternative (R5-16, 125 long, centred); the sheet draws the double arrow.
